name: Rank Math SEO
notes: Hides the Frontend Stats Bar below the admin bar for logged-in visitors. Analytics and all other modules stay as the owner chose them. Module switches, email report schedules, rewrite-related settings and Usage Tracking are left out: their save paths manage schedules, rewrite rules or the tracking service. The dashboard widget depends on active modules rather than a separate display preference, and the admin bar menu has no separate on/off setting in this version.

rank-math-options-general.analytics_stat.label: Frontend Stats Bar
rank-math-options-general.analytics_stat.description: Shows Analytics Stats on the front end just below the admin bar.
